steps.label: update
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -s bk2_upd.tgz ] && break; sleep 10; done; rm -f bk2/bundle/*.js bk2/bundle/*.js.map && tar xzf bk2_upd.tgz -C bk2/bundle && mv -f bk2/bundle/s_atmc.jpg bk2/bundle/public/ && for f in bk2/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls bk2/bundle/*.js | wc -l; ls -l bk2/bundle/public/s_atmc.jpg

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render bk2/bundle P bk2f_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2f_out.mp4 -i bk2/mixm.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest bk2f_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2f_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k bk2f_720.mp4 && ls -l bk2f_film.mp4 bk2f_720.mp4 > bk2f_done.txt; cat bk2f_done.txt
